title: For PR 4: under a hold the chat mirror holds the page's profile beside the newly read medication and screening lists; and an own-save read that began before a whole re-read can write the page's earlier profile after that re-read
evidence: Noted in the R13 PR 3 review (2026-11-25, US-34 AC9). Lists: useRecordReads.ts mirrorRecord writes result.medications and result.screenings at every values read. Ordering: the values read's profile choice (useRecordApply.ts:188) against the whole re-read's mirror write (useRecordReads.ts:59). To settle with the H16 read check.
